description: Election Commission - Elected Mr. M. Emiliyampillai as Vice Chairman of the Poonakary P/S
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman in a local government body (Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with an electoral process at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official, which falls squarely under the Elections classification (Type 7).
